cases.name: same_request_recalculation_and_committed_reply_discard_lookup
cases.notes: A completed actual RPC but held outer transaction until B Lock was observed; no extra row/advisory locks were injected. Saved reply deliberately discarded at application level, not TCP packet loss.

readOnlyAudit.guardSql: select current_database() db,current_setting('server_version_num')::int version,current_setting('data_directory') directory,inet_server_port() port,inet_server_addr()::text address
readOnlyAudit.sql: select a.quantity,r.saved_result is null and r.completed_at is null and r.completion_order is null as failed_request_uncommitted,(select count(*)::int from calculation_results c where c.project_id=$1) calculations,(select count(*)::int from calculation_results c where c.project_id=$1 and c.is_latest) latest_calculations,(select count(*)::int from audit_logs l where l.project_id=$1 and l.action='recalculate_project_atomic') recalc_audits,(select count(*)::int from cocal_recalc_private.requests x where x.project_id=$1 and x.saved_result is not null) completed_requests from emission_activities a join cocal_recalc_private.requests r on r.project_id=a.project_id and r.request_id=$2 where a.project_id=$1
assertions: one fresh calculation and one latest result
